title: Introduction
summary: Read real traffic data, understand vehicle count and temperature, and draw simple graphs.
practices: Devise a program to import, load and view dataset.
Create a program to display the summary and statistics of the dataset.

title: Linear models
summary: Use current traffic volume to predict the next hour, then classify light or heavy traffic.
practices: Implement linear regression to perform prediction.
Implement Bayesian logistic regression and SVM for classification.

title: Clustering & PCA
summary: Group similar traffic hours and reduce vehicle count and temperature to one new feature.
practices: Implement K-means clustering, mixtures of Gaussians and Hierarchical clustering algorithm to categorize data.
Create a program to perform PCA.

title: Hidden Markov models
summary: Use a two-state HMM to predict whether the next observed traffic hour is busy.
practices: Implement HMM to predict the sequential data.

title: Combining models
summary: Compare a small decision tree with random forest and AdaBoost classifiers.
practices: Implement CART learning algorithms to perform categorization.
Implement Ensemble learning models to perform classification.
